description: Gas Pipe Infrastructure - North London - Shared is a dataset listed in Cadent Gas open data portal, an open data portal of a gas distribution network operator, published or maintained by Cadent Gas Ltd. The main assets that Cadent owns are gas pipes.These gas pipes move gas from where gas enters our network to where it exits our network. This dataset contains information on high pressure and intermediate pressure pipe gas assets within our North London network. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Asset, Shared. Its keywords are Gas Pipeline, Pipe, Pipeline, High Pressure, Intermediate Pressure, Gas Pipe. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Cadent Gas Data Sharing Agreement. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-cadent-open-data-portal.
